snippet.title: Midnight Joy Ride Demo Trailer | JamPre
snippet.description:
First trailer for our game Midnight Joy Ride! The demo is already available on Itch and Game Jolt.

Play the Demo:::
https://jampre.itch.io/midnight-joy-ride-demo
https://gamejolt.com/games/midnight-joy-ride/1028600

Learn more about JamPre:::
https://www.jampre.xyz
https://www.instagram.com/j.ampre/

Background music:::
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VBSP75pr2bg


Game credits:::
 - Lucian A. Meister | Programmer, Writer, Voice Actor, Sound Designer, 3D Artist
 - Paul C. Zdesenko | Writer, Voice Actor, Playtester
 - Bernard Correya | 3D Artist
 - Greta Christensen | Sound Artist
 - Nelson Santos | Painter
 - Mattis Schmidt | Voice Actor
 - Johannes Tibursky | Voice Actor
 - Wladislav Holz | Voice Actor


Please note that the game & demo are NOT finished yet but is being updated on a weekly basis!

Thanks for playing and enjoying the Midnight Joy Ride so far!
